title: Maestro
description:
`maestro.qubit` is a high-performance C++ quantum simulator by Qoro Quantum.

Recommended for:

- Statevector simulations with 20+ qubits requiring maximum speed.
- Large-scale circuits (100+ qubits) using the MPS backend.
- Shot-based sampling from MPS states.
- Native mid-circuit measurements with true wavefunction collapse.
- GPU-accelerated simulation via a custom CUDA MPS backend.
features: Statevector, MPS, Stabilizer, Tensor Network, Pauli Propagator, and Path Integral backends
GPU acceleration via custom CUDA MPS Backend
Batched Hamiltonian evaluation in a single C++ call
warning: GPU acceleration (`simulator_type="Gpu"`) requires a separate license from [Qoro Quantum](https://maestro.qoroquantum.net). CPU-based simulation is available to all users.
